item: Volume backups import verify and restore on Windows: the manifest read no longer calls os.set_blocking
summary: load_manifest switched its descriptor back to blocking with os.set_blocking, which on Windows works on pipes only, so every volume manifest read there as cannot be read (OSError) and a volume backup could not be imported, verified or restored. The call is gone (O_NONBLOCK changes nothing for a regular file). The open adds O_BINARY where it exists. The regular-file check (name and descriptor) and the size cap (name and descriptor) stay, and the file opened must be the file examined (device and inode), which refuses a name swapped for a link where there is no O_NOFOLLOW; a mismatch is confirmed by a second look at the name, since FAT or SMB may report the same identity at different widths.
